name: nav
title: Nav
description: A vertical list of destinations for a sidebar.
use: The destinations of an app or a settings page, stacked in a sidebar, with at most one level of folding groups. A group is a native details, so it folds without script.

instead.when: The rows nest many levels deep
The links are sibling pages inside a page
The links are the path above the current page
The destinations go along the top of the page

keyboard.action: On the summary of a group: fold or unfold it, as details does

platform.fallback: A group opens and closes at once, without the transition to its own height

classes.name: nav
classes.description: The list, on a nav with a label

classes.name: nav-item
classes.description: A destination: a link, a button, or the summary of a group. Quiet until touched; the current one rises as a small sheet

classes.name: nav-end
classes.description: A count, a shortcut or a badge at the end of a row, in tabular figures

classes.name: nav-label
classes.description: A quiet caption over a set of rows

classes.name: nav-group
classes.description: A details that folds a set of rows under its summary

classes.name: nav-toggle
classes.description: On the summary of a group: adds a chevron at the end of the row, which turns over while the group is open

classes.name: nav-sub
classes.description: The rows under a group, set in from the icon column on a hairline guide

states.name: current
states.description: The row rises as a small sheet, in strong ink

states.name: selected
states.description: Drawn the same, for a row that selects a view in place

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link with its href removed: disabled ink

states.name: open
states.description: The rows under the group show and the chevron turns over

properties.name: --nav-item-height
properties.description: Row height; at least 2.75rem on touch screens
